52d143af2b0f8d7beb9f.text: In this lesson, you will discover the Communicative Styles and how, when, and where they are used.

5eb14ed01aa5f0207d10.text: Communication helps us to express our thoughts and feelings. Having your own styles in conveying messages and knowing these styles lead to a better understanding and successful transfer of ideas.

e2adb739d3e6679fb119.text: The purpose of the different styles of speech is to help people know the specific approach they should use in every situation, person, and place.

e78e52a8610f4ed55f51.text: Communicative styles are patterns of speaking characterized by distinctive pronunciation, vocabulary, intent, participants, and grammatical structures.

3b0aee3bea76d6efae6e.text: A communicative style, according to Martin Joos (1976), a linguist and German professor, it refers to the form of language that the speaker utilized, which is characterized by the level of formality. Still, according to Joos, speech style is identified into five types: frozen, formal, consultative, casual, and intimate.

2e3d4834c7468a44ef10.text: Also known as fixed speech, it is the highest form of communicative style, which is often used in respectful situations or formal ceremonies like Shakespearean plays, weddings, funerals, and more. It uses the complex grammatical sentence structure and vocabulary that is only known by experts in that field

31dcb82b368f730a6390.text: National pledge, anthem, school creeds, marriage ceremonies, speech for a state ceremony

fb69fff116631962d34d.text: Conversational style breaks most of the grammatical rules. It is aimed at the target audience and addresses them as such. It's informal in form. Uses language that resembles conversation. It is warm and natural, easy to understand. The objective of this style is to engage the listener or readers.
